en: A black and white postcard featuring a forested mountainous landscape with a building complex perched on a ridge. The complex includes what appears to be a station and possibly a hotel or guesthouse. There is a prominent road leading to the building, and a railway or funicular track is visible among the trees. The caption at the top reads: 'MENDEL. Station Mendel mit Mendelbahn, Mendelstrasse und Monte Roen.'
